jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Your Future Evolves Here**

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

**Position Summary:**

The Software Engineer designs, develops, tests, and maintains software applications using modern programming languages and frameworks. Working in an Agile, globally distributed team, this role partners with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate requirements into technical specifications and deliver clean, maintainable, and reliable code.

This individual works with minimal supervision on assigned features, actively learning and adopting the development methods, frameworks, and patterns defined for the role and by the team, and contributes to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems. The role is expected to use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every delivered result.

**AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations:**

Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on solution design, evaluating alternatives, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Design and Development**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications for assigned features using modern programming languages and frameworks.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, following the team’s established best practices, patterns, and coding standards.
* Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems.

**Quality and Continuous Improvement**

* Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, functionality, and maintainability, and seek feedback to continuously improve skills.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues and bugs in a timely manner.
* Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Follow and help reinforce the team’s development processes and standards, helping peers understand the benefits and risks of exceptions.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and methodologies, and stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends.

**AI-Enabled Delivery**

* Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis activities.
* Apply AI-assisted development techniques throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, coding, testing, debugging, and documentation.
* Evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness before use.
* Learn and adopt the prompts, skills, agents, and AI-assisted development patterns defined by the team, and share improvements that benefit the team.
* Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.

**Governance and Compliance**

* Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices.
* Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling.
* Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex, scalable applications.
* Proficiency in C# or Python and familiarity with their ecosystems.
* Working knowledge of relational database development, preferably using SQL Server.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures.
* Familiarity with Git-based version control (e.g., GitHub, Azure Git) and collaborative coding workflows, including pull requests.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a globally distributed team.
* Strong communication skills, openness to feedback, and the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience related to HL7 FHIR. Understanding resource-first FHIR patterns. Comfortable reading FHIR implementation guides.
* Experience in healthcare data domains such as providers, members, prior authorizations, and claims.
* Exposure to AI-assisted development pla

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

**WHAT WE'RE DOING**  
  
Come join the EADGE-T team and be part of an effort to upgrade the program’s technology and bring new capabilities to the UAE customer. The EADGE-T system is an integrated air missile defense, air battle management capability for the UAE integrating existing sensors, weapons as well as new capabilities.  
  
The Tech Refresh will focus on Foundational / Cyber Security Enhancements. Join us and become a part of the team that is actively designing and developing the updated baseline and get the opportunity to work with an international customer!  
  
**THE WORK**  
  
EADGE-T is seeking a software engineer to join one of the agile development teams. In this role, you will:

* Decompose higher-level roadmap features into actionable work items
* Design, Implement, and integrate/test software features
* Perform peer reviews for fellow software engineers and debug issues as they arise
* Participate in technical discussions to define/solve overarching software architecture needs
* Collaborate with cross-functional peers to better understand project requirements and customer/stakeholder needs

**WHO WE ARE**  
  
EADGE-T has a geographically dispersed project team that executes in an agile – scrum setting.  
  
Team members have the ability to interface with an international customer and learn more about the technologies and processes being developed for this upgrade. If the desire to succeed in a challenging and complex problem space excites you, EADGE-T may be the perfect venture!  
  
**WHY JOIN US**  
  
Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life - At Lockheed Martin, we prioritize the well-being of our employees. We offer flexible schedules, competitive pay, and a comprehensive benefits package to support your healthy, fulfilling life both at and outside of work

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Proficiency with Python and Java
* RHEL/Windows experience
* Experience working in agile environments (Kanban/Scrum)
* Experience across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
* Proficiency with version control and collaboration tools (e.g. Git, GitLab, Jira, Confluence)
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design principles
* Experience with automated testing and continuous integration (unit tests, CI/CD pipelines)
* 3+ years of relevant work experience (An advanced degree may be substituted for up to 2 years of work experience)

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Experience with Services, Microservices, Software Factories, Cloud-native and Service-Oriented Architectures
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm
* Strong background in CI/CD tooling (Git, GitLab, Jenkins) and automated testing frameworks
* Experience with test-driven development, continuous integration, and regression testing expertise
* Cybersecurity knowledge for software products (user authentication, data encryption) and secure development handling of classified information
* Active Secret Clearance

**Pay Information**

**GeoZone Definition:** GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

* Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $101400.00 - $188200.00
  + Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
* Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $91200.00 - $169400.00
  + Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
* Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $81100.00 - $150500.00
  + Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
* Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $72900.00 - $135500.00
  + Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only.  
Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

* Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
* For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

Atlassian’s Gen AI Platform team builds the shared foundation for creating, deploying, and operating production AI agents. We provide reusable runtimes, APIs, tools, plugins, and operational capabilities so product teams can focus on customer experiences.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer who enjoys building reliable backend systems and platforms that make other engineers more effective.

Responsibilities:

* Build and operate backend services, APIs, libraries, and developer tools for our agent platform.
* Own well-defined capabilities from design through testing, rollout, and production support.
* Develop stable, self-service interfaces for defining agents, connecting tools, and extending platform behaviour.
* Improve reliability, performance, observability, and developer experience.
* Investigate failures across distributed services and agent execution flows.
* Collaborate with product and platform teams and participate in code and design reviews.
* Participate in on-call and turn operational learning into lasting improvements.

Pay Ranges:

In The **United States**, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

**Zone A**: $150,300 - $196,225

**Zone B**: $135,270 - $176,603

**Zone C**: $124,749 - $162,867

Qualifications:

* Experience building and operating production backend or platform services.
* Proficiency in a language such as TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Go, or Python.
* Understanding of APIs, asynchronous processing, data storage, cloud infrastructure, and testing.
* Sound judgment around correctness, reliability, maintainability, and delivery trade-offs.
* Strong learning agility and clear communication.

Experience with AI agents, LLM applications, MCP, developer platforms, distributed runtimes, or Kubernetes is desired but not required.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

**Working at Atlassian**  
  
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities.
  
We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company.  
  
**Your Future Team**  
The mission of Atlassian is to unleash potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. AI/ML is significantly transforming how teams come together to plan, track, and deliver work across software and business teams using our products. We are looking for rockstar Machine learning engineers to come help us to further this mission and help make teams more productive leveraging AI across our product portfolio.

Responsibilities:

**What you'll do**  
  
As a Machine Learning engineer, you will work on the development and implementation of the cutting edge machine learning algorithms, training models, collaborating with product, engineering, and analytics teams, to build the AI functionalities into each Atlassian products and services.
  
  
Your daily responsibilities will encompass a broad spectrum of tasks such as designing system and model architectures, conducting rigorous experimentation and model evaluations.
  
  
You will be responsible for application of AI/ML to various product problems to improve Atlassian products and actively contribute toAtlassian Intelligence features.

Pay Ranges:

In The **United States**, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

**Zone A**: $178,200 - $232,650

**Zone B**: $160,380 - $209,385

**Zone C**: $147,906 - $193,100

Qualifications:

**On your first day, we’ll expect you to have**  
  
Bachelor's or Master's degree (preferably a Computer Science degree or equivalent experience).  
  
Expertise in Python or Java with and the ability to write performant production-quality code, familiarity with SQL.  
  
Knowledge of Spark and cloud data environments is a plus (e.g. AWS, Databricks)  
  
Experience building and scaling machine learning models using large amounts of data  
  
Experience working in a consumer or B2C space for a SaaS product provider, or the enterprise/B2B space  
  
Experience in developing deep learning-based models and working on LLM-related applications  
  
Excelling in solving ambiguous and complex problems, being able to navigate through uncertain situations, breaking down complex challenges into manageable components and developing innovative solutions  
  
**Compensation**  
  
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. To support this goal, the baseline of our range is higher than that of the typical market range, but in turn we expect to hire most candidates near this baseline.
  
Base pay within the range is ultimately determined by a candidate's skills, expertise, or experience.
  
  
In the United States, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:  
Zone A: $178,200 - $232,650  
Zone B: $160,380 - $209,385  
Zone C: $147,906 - $193,100  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.  
Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones (http://go.atlassian.com/payzones) for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.  
  
**Our perks & benefits**  
Atlassian offers a variety of perks and benefits to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community.  
Our offerings include health coverage, paid volunteer days, wellness resources, and so much more. Visit (http://go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits) to learn more.  
  
**About Atlassian**  
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be  
impossible alone, possible together.  
Cookies are used on this site to assist in continually improving the candidate experience and all the interaction data we store of our visitors is anonymous.
  
Learn more about your rights on our Privacy Policy (https://www.icims.com/legal/privacy-notice-website/) page.  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender  
identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process.  
  
Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh (http://go.atlassian.com/crh).

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
Overview/ Job Responsibilities:

Entarian is seeking a Software Developer - Space Weather Scientific Software to support the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) Space Warfare Directorate.

**Responsibilities include, but not limited to:**

* Researching and developing space weather science phenomenology modeling, prediction, and forecast from science algorithms/prototypes into operational software applications, and advancing current R2O practices in methodology, processes, tools, etc.
* Hands-on coding as well as technical management of interacting with customers.
* Designing, developing, integrating, and maintaining space weather science applications and perform full life-cycle software development activities.

Work is located at Kirtland AFB in Albuquerque, NM, but can be performed remotely with travel to Kirtland AFB up to 2 times per year up to 2-3 weeks.

Salary range: $110,000.00 - $122,000.00

Minimum Qualifications:

* US Active Secret level clearance
* BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in general software engineering development in delivering mission-critical system applications, preferably science-based systems supporting NOAA/NASA/DoD
* Familiarity with AGILE software development practices with the ability to use and maintain make-based build tools and SCM-Git for large-scale and distributed software development
* Experience in developing with C/Fortran/C++, and Python in Linux environments
* Excellent verbal written communications skills
* Must be self-motivated and adaptable in a dynamic hybrid R&D and production environment
* Experience in developing Cloud-native applications and helping to mature DevSecOps and Platform Engineering practices
* Ability to rescue/reverse-engineer troubled scientific code
* Experience working with multiple stakeholders and gathering detailed user requirements

Desired Qualifications:

* Master's degree
* Experience or background in space weather science
* Javascript/HTML/CSS web programming experience
* Knowledge in conducting and managing system-level testing
* Knowledgeable about information assurance practices in compliance with best practices security policies and procedures
* Familiarity with research-2-operations (R2O) methodology
* GitOps, and other foundational AWSGovCloud technology

About Us:

Formed through the strategic union of Sev1Tech and ERT, Entarian is a premier provider of mission-critical engineering and technology solutions. Founded on a legacy of excellence dating back to 1993, Entarian is a product of an evolved and fully diversified engineering and federal technology leader. From deep space to defense and civilian missions, Entarian delivers secure, mission-aligned digital solutions that drive national resilience and operational effectiveness. We don't just support modernization; we define it.

**Join the Mission and Start your Career Journey:** Apply Directly via our Careers Portal **Connect,** **Referrals & Inquiries?** **Email the team:** **careers@entarian.com**

*Entarian is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.*
